params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$runnerDir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven'
$listeners=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Runner.Listener.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($runnerDir,[System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) })
foreach($p in $listeners){ Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
$dup=Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) 'HeavenGitHubActionsRunner.cmd'
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dup -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-runner-v2-reconfigure'
if(Test-Path $tmp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force}
git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $tmp
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('git clone failed: '+$LASTEXITCODE)}
$src=Join-Path $tmp 'heaven-bridge\install-github-runner.ps1'
$text=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $src
$text=$text.Replace('$ForceReconfigure = $false','$ForceReconfigure = $true')
$patched=Join-Path $tmp 'heaven-bridge\install-github-runner-reconfigure.ps1'
Set-Content -LiteralPath $patched -Value $text -Encoding UTF8
& $patched
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('runner installer failed: '+$LASTEXITCODE)}
